evidence.quote: Owned intelligence is not the same as rented intelligence.

observations.why: Contrasts owned vs. rented — a proportionality framing that distinguishes what you keep from what you pay to use, enacting market-pricing logic.

evidence.quote: the perspective is the asset you keep

observations.why: Designates the perspective as a retained asset against a commoditized substrate — cost-benefit proportionality between what is pooled and what is kept.
